data_description.grid_import: Direction-separated cumulative AC energy imported at the grid connection point.

data_description.synchronous_sources_confirmed: Confirm that every role comes from the same atomic physical reading and exposes its exact shared UTC period end in co2saver_period_end.

sources.description: Select cumulative, direction-separated AC energy sensors that are registered and enabled in Home Assistant. Each source must be a sensor with device class energy, state class total or total_increasing, and unit Wh, kWh, or MWh. All roles must originate from one atomic physical reading, expose exactly the same authoritative UTC timestamp in co2saver_period_end, and be measured at least every five minutes. That timestamp must come from the meter or gateway, not a rounded Home Assistant time. Each role must be published no more than 60 seconds after the period end, with no more than 60 seconds between role publications. Confirm this contract to continue.
sources.title: Select cumulative energy sources

storage.description: Specify whether the plant has a battery storage system. This choice only extends the staged configuration draft; it does not create or change a Config Entry, Store, battery-origin ledger, listener, polling runner, or accounting result.

data.battery_sources_confirmed: I confirm the battery source directions and synchronized measurement contract

data_description.battery_charge: Direction-separated cumulative energy measured at the battery's AC input while charging.
data_description.battery_discharge: Direction-separated cumulative energy measured at the battery's AC output while discharging.
data_description.battery_identity: Required when reconfiguring an existing battery; no option is preselected. Choose replacement even if the meter entities stayed the same, because CO2 Saver cannot infer a physical replacement behind unchanged meters. Choosing the same battery keeps its internal identity; choosing replacement creates one new draft identity. The choice is not stored as a lasting flag. When the complete flow commits an effective change, it starts a prospective segment, conservatively quarantines prior battery inventory, and never recalculates history.
data_description.battery_sources_confirmed: Confirm that charge and discharge use the correct separate directions and come from the same atomic physical reading as every selected PV and grid role, with exactly the same co2saver_period_end.
data_description.round_trip_efficiency_percent: Enter a plain decimal greater than 0 and no more than 100. The suggested 90% must still be visibly confirmed.
data_description.usable_capacity_kwh: Enter the usable energy available at the battery's AC output from 0.1 through 1000 kWh. There is no default.

storage_sources.description: Select separate cumulative AC energy sensors for battery charge and discharge. They must be registered and enabled and meet the same sensor, energy device class, total or total_increasing state class, and Wh/kWh/MWh requirements as the PV and grid sources. Every energy role must come from the same atomic physical reading, expose exactly the same authoritative UTC timestamp in co2saver_period_end, and be measured at least every five minutes. Publication must occur within 60 seconds of the period end and within 60 seconds across roles. Enter capacity and efficiency as plain decimal text with a dot; commas, exponent notation, and surrounding whitespace are rejected.
storage_sources.title: Configure battery storage

user.description: Choose how CO2 Saver obtains PV generation. This starts a staged setup; no plant is created until every configuration step is available and completed.

configuration_invalid.description: The configuration for {name} is incomplete, invalid, or uses an unsupported version. Review the integration settings and installed version. Accounting remains stopped; stored results are not replaced with zero.

sources_changed.description: A source required by {name} was removed or disabled. Open the integration settings and reconfigure the source. Accounting is stopped; existing totals are preserved. Source names or entity IDs cannot prove that a replacement measures the same physical flow.

abort.already_repaired: The stored accounting is already available again.
abort.entry_missing: The affected CO2 Saver configuration no longer exists.

error.confirmation_required: Explicitly confirm the accounting reset before continuing.
error.reload_failed: The integration did not finish loading successfully. Resolve the reported problem and retry loading.
error.repair_failed: The repair could not be completed and verified. The issue remains open; check local storage and retry loading before attempting another reset.
error.unload_failed: The integration could not be stopped safely. No reset was started. Retry after resolving the unload problem.

data.confirm_reset: I have reviewed the backup, data-loss, and statistics consequences and confirm the reset

confirm.description:
Back up Home Assistant before continuing. Resetting starts a new accounting generation with all CO2 Saver result totals at zero. Battery contents become unknown and receive no PV credit until measurements prove their origin again. The first valid measurement becomes a new baseline; gaps are never estimated.

Existing generation files are retained for manual recovery. An existing unreadable manifest is backed up and verified; old generations are never guessed or automatically reassigned. Sensor identities remain unchanged. Recorder keeps earlier history and continues its statistics in a new counter cycle; net sensors publish a new last_reset time so the reset is not counted as negative savings.

Confirm only if you accept these consequences. Canceling this step does not reset the accounting.

An already started, incomplete repair is recorded persistently and resumes the same generation after a restart or in a new dialog. A failed loading attempt does not trigger another reset.
confirm.title: Confirm accounting reset

init.description:
CO2 Saver cannot safely read or verify the stored accounting for {name}. Processing is stopped to preserve the existing data. Retry loading the existing generation first. A reset is available only with explicit confirmation after reviewing the data-loss and statistics consequences.

Try loading the existing accounting again without resetting it. If the stored data cannot be recovered, review the separate reset option.
init.title: Repair stored CO₂ accounting
